adjuster_notes: Insured's car engine seized after being driven through a flooded street during heavy rain. No Engine & Gearbox Protection endorsement on file.
Insured reversed into a concrete pillar in a parking lot, denting the rear bumper and taillight. Straightforward own-damage repair, no third party involved.
An earthquake caused visible structural cracks in the insured's home. No Earthquake Extension endorsement is on file for this policy.
A kitchen fire damaged part of the building structure. No neighbouring or tenant property was involved. Standard building cover only.
Insured holds IMT-28 Zero Dep cover. A pothole accident damaged the front-left tyre and the bumper in the same incident. Insured expects full reimbursement on the tyre under Zero Dep.
Insured's home was burgled overnight. The back door was left unlocked; there are no signs of forced or violent entry. Electronics were stolen from the living room.
Windshield cracked from a stone chip on the highway. Insured holds glass breakage cover and is not claiming any other damage.
Insured's vehicle was stolen from a parking lot 95 days ago. Police have not yet issued a Non-Traceable Certificate.
Insured collided with a divider late at night. Breathalyzer report on file confirms the insured was driving under the influence of alcohol at the time of the accident.
A large tree fell onto the roof during a storm, causing impact damage. Standard building cover, no endorsements.
